_comment: The shipped read manifest: every scanner, the paths it reads, the fields it stores, the fields it deliberately does not read, and its default enabled state. Rendered verbatim in the app's 'What Vole reads' screen. A managed policy can force a scanner on (the point for fleet deployment) but that must be visible to the employee, never silent — resolveScannerSwitch reports 'locked' when a pin decides.

scanners.name: collector-health
fieldsNeverRead: anything beyond the pidfile's own two keys

scanners.name: tier2-extras
paths: gateway config files named in launchd arguments (.yaml/.yml/.json)
Chrome content_settings exceptions (origin + capability, no content)
readability probes (O_RDONLY canaries) on agent store roots

scanners.name: shell-history
fieldsStored: byte receipt (bytes read / windows matched / rows stored)

scanners.name: model-routes
fieldsStored: alias, api_base host, key presence (never the key)
fieldsNeverRead: API keys and other credential material

scanners.name: execution-contexts
paths: editor workspace storage (VS Code/Cursor globalStorage, workspaceStorage)

scanners.name: vscode-state
fieldsStored: extension ids, activation counts, declared models, usage counts
metadata, hashes and counts only — no prompt, message or tool-argument content

scanners.name: deleted-sessions
fieldsStored: counts of vendor-deleted sessions per store
fieldsNeverRead: the deleted sessions themselves (gone by definition)

scanners.name: os-intelligence
paths: macOS system surfaces: default domains, mdfind-declared assets, OS version facts
fieldsNeverRead: file contents beyond the declared keys

scanners.name: scan-access
paths: the paths every other scanner already reads (read-access probes, TCC canary)
fieldsStored: probe outcome per path: ok / eperm / enoent, errno, launch_context
fieldsNeverRead: file contents — the probe opens, never reads

scanners.name: coverage
paths: agent store directories (sizes, mtimes, session-file counts)
fieldsStored: session counts, byte sizes, last-write times

scanners.name: browser-grants
paths: browser profile extension stores (Chrome/Edge/Brave/Arc profiles on disk)
fieldsStored: extension ids, install sources, host permissions

scanners.name: ai-hosts
paths: browser History SQLite (visit counts per AI host)
fieldsStored: per-host visit counts only — no URL, title or page content
fieldsNeverRead: URLs, titles, page content — counts only by construction

scanners.name: ai-deps
paths: package manifests under the user home (package.json devDependencies of AI tools)
fieldsStored: tool name, declared version, provider keys

scanners.name: editor-census
paths: editor application bundles and extension directories
fieldsStored: app version, extension ids, version, commit, builtin flag

scanners.name: editor-stores
paths: editor session/chat stores on disk (Copilot, Cline, …)
fieldsStored: metadata, hashes and counts only — no prompt, message or tool-argument content

scanners.name: structured-sinks
paths: structured agent stores (codex sessions, Copilot session store, Cursor tracking DB, Antigravity brain, Devin ACP messages)
fieldsStored: metadata, hashes and counts only — no prompt, message or tool-argument content

scanners.name: net-ledgers
paths: no disk reads — derived from rows already in the local store
fieldsStored: destinations, hosts, statement classes from stored call shapes
fieldsNeverRead: nothing new is read from disk
